title: Wrap a config reader in a Promise
statement:
У `legacy-config.ts` є `readConfigLegacy(name, callback)` з колбеком `(error: Error | null, value?: string)`.

Напиши `readConfig(name): Promise<string>`.

```ts
readConfig('baseUrl');   // resolves 'http://localhost:5173'
readConfig('unknown');   // rejects Error('Config unknown is not set')
```
hints: Та сама схема: `new Promise((resolve, reject) => readConfigLegacy(name, (error, value) => …))`.
